SRC-255:R001.text: Separate IMPLEMENTATION_COMPLETE, ACCEPTANCE_COMPLETE, and EXTERNAL_GATE_PENDING so states do not silently collapse into one DONE verdict

SRC-255:R002.text: Retain compatibility with legitimate no-publish SHIP completion when publication is held or not requested

SRC-255:R003.text: Strengthen finding_invalidated to require a typed premise-disproof record or structured invalidation reason rather than an arbitrary same-ticket E-### event

SRC-255:R004.text: A requirement that is still valid but blocked externally must not be closed under finding_invalidated

SRC-255:R005.text: If only part of a ticket is fulfilled, require an authorized scope split or durable continuation; never silently redefine the original verify field

SRC-255:R006.text: Apply semantic closure enforcement through canonical finish_ticket and ticket done with zero-write refusal before invalid closure

SRC-255:R007.text: A same-ticket event that merely records preparation, progress or unrelated checks without premise disproof is refused with an explicit diagnostic code

SRC-255:R008.text: Genuine typed premise invalidation with verifiable disproof is accepted

SRC-255:R009.text: Continuation and convergence reporting must distinguish unworked tasks, fulfilled acceptance, pending external gates, and publication prohibition

SRC-255:R010.text: Executable regression tests prove refusals on invalid premise citations, acceptance on genuine disproof, and local SHIP compatibility

SRC-255:R011.text: Historical valid closures and immutable logs are preserved without retroactive rewrites
